0022600204.text: The Charlotte Hornets host the Cleveland Cavaliers in the Hornets' 11th game of 2026-27, with Charlotte at 3-7 (2-4 at home) and 10th in the East after six straight losses, while Cleveland is 5-5 and 7th in the East after a loss in its most recent game. Charlotte is without Brandon Miller (groin soreness), Dennis Schroder (hamstring strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps), and Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Sam Merrill (elbow). The teams have not met yet this season, and Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 118-113 win in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
